item.title: Version 2.3.2
item.description:
What's New in 2.3.2

Improvements

  • A clearer, tidier Settings panel — Settings are now organized into General, Security, and Screen & Power sections, and every switch carries a short note explaining exactly what it does — including "Keep screen on", which now says up front that the stream keeps this Mac's resolution instead of resizing to fit the connected device.

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed the Settings panel overflowing the window — The panel could grow past the window edge and overlap the screen behind it, with no way to scroll. It now scrolls smoothly and always fits the window.

item.title: Version 2.3.1
item.description:
What's New in 2.3.1

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed your password being rejected when unlocking this Mac remotely — If this Mac's screen had gone to sleep, a connected device could see the lock screen and type into it, but every password was refused as incorrect — even the right one. Typing on a keyboard plugged into the Mac was the only way in. Connecting now wakes the screen first, so your password is accepted the first time. This also covers the sign-in screen after a restart, and locking this Mac from your device is now safely reversible from that same device.
